piece.headline: HAALAND BLANKS AGAIN, SUKRUT STRETCHES CLEAR
piece.standfirst: 15 armbands on Haaland, a 2-point return, and the leader still pulls further ahead.
piece.big_picture: Haaland blanked for the second week running and the armband crowd paid. Sukrut was one of them, yet his lead over Aditya Dalal grew to 24. Dalal's long hot streak finally cooled. Pradnyesh's Tavernier call shows what going elsewhere could pay.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Aryamann swapped Mbeumo and Kostoulas for Wirtz and Evanilson. Best transfer of the week, and a big reason for the move into the Gold spots.
piece.one_to_watch: Aryamann and Anuj are split by 6 points at the Gold spots line. If Aryamann's new signings keep delivering, he could stay ahead. If Anuj fixes his bench, the gap could close fast.

winners.name: Aryamann
winners.verdict: Up to 4th, with Wirtz and Evanilson doing the work. The Gold spots are in sight.

winners.name: Pradnyesh
winners.verdict: Tavernier with the armband, and nobody else picked him. Nerve rewarded. Still 19th for now.

winners.name: Arya
winners.verdict: A.Becker was started by nobody else here, and returned 7. A quiet pick that paid off.

losers.name: Aryan
losers.verdict: A 5-week run above average ended. The 6 points paid on McGinn and Dasilva made it worse.

losers.name: Aary
losers.verdict: Sold Lewis-Potter, who then hauled. Cruel timing. 6 weeks below average now, so a gentle word: better days are possible.

losers.name: Anuj
losers.verdict: 18 points sat on the bench while the Gold spots slipped away. Third a month ago, and the slide is hard to ignore.

ratings.l: 5 straight weeks above average, and the Gold spots now in reach.
